title.zh: ICBA Sues OCC Over Crypto Trust Charters
title.en: ICBA Sues OCC Over Crypto Trust Charters

current_state.zh: The ICBA has sued the OCC to block its crypto trust chartering regime, challenging Protego's conditional approval and seeking to stop the agency from issuing further charters under the contested rule and guidance.
current_state.en: The ICBA has sued the OCC to block its crypto trust chartering regime, challenging Protego's conditional approval and seeking to stop the agency from issuing further charters under the contested rule and guidance.
